# Desk: technical specification

Version 1.0.0 of the specification: no objects yet. The chapters follow arc42, and a chapter with nothing in the specification is left out.

## 1. Introduction and goals

A lending desk whose token carries its roles in capitals.

## 8. Cross-cutting concepts

### Permissions

Access is fail-closed: every operation, command and page names the one permission it needs, and only the roles below grant one.

| Permission | desk-staff | desk-supervisor |
|---|---|---|
| loans.read | yes | yes |
| loans.writeoff | | yes |

Every role goes on the wire in upper snake case (info.roleNames): in a token's roles claim and in the tables the permission check reads, a role is its name in capitals with each hyphen an underscore.

| Role | On the wire |
|---|---|
| desk-staff | DESK_STAFF |
| desk-supervisor | DESK_SUPERVISOR |
